sermons.title: Sermon 553 | Election no Discouragement to Seeking Souls

scripture.verse: "I will be gracious upon whom I will be gracious, and will show mercy upon whom I will show mercy."
"He that endureth to the end shall be saved."

scripture.reference: Sinners of whom the chief I am.

scripture.verse: "A bundle of myrrh is my well-beloved unto me; he shall lie all night betwixt my breasts."

sermons.title: Sermon 560 | Christ is Glorious—Let Us Make Him Known

scripture.verse: "And he shall stand and feed in the strength of the Lord, in the majesty of the name of the Lord his God; and they shall abide: for now shall he be great unto the ends of the earth."
